kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نستقتل (form X)
# نَسْتَقْتِلُ (nastaqtilu) /nas.taq.ti.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَقْتَلَ (istaqtala)
# نَسْتَقْتِلَ (nastaqtila) /nas.taq.ti.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَقْتَلَ (istaqtala)
# نَسْتَقْتِلْ (nastaqtil) /nas.taq.til/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَقْتَلَ (istaqtala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
